title: 644. Valid Triangle Number

examples.explanation: Triples (2,3,4) once and (2,2,3) twice satisfy the side rule, giving 3.
All triples except (2,3,4)? Actually sorting to [2,3,4,4] leaves four valid triples.

hints: Sort the lengths first; then the triangle test for a triple reduces to checking the two smaller sides against the largest.
Fix the largest side and use two pointers on the prefix: when the pair sum beats the largest, every index between them also works.
Move the right pointer down on success (counting a batch) and the left pointer up otherwise.
